evidence_class: Scoped fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fixture operator credential, fakeredis, fixture clock; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
failure_fixture: tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/fleet-broadcasts.json with the Racing store wrapper in tests/test_swarm_v2_broadcasts.py, which runs a concurrent write before each commit
interfaces: scripts.swarm_v2.broadcasts.FleetBroadcasts.publish: grant-only; the author is the seat and execution id of the validated launch grant, the brain defaults to and must equal the grant's brain, the project must be one of the grant's projects; agents cannot publish critical or nuclear
FleetBroadcasts.publish_operator: operator credential resolved by the operator callback; a launch grant is refused as an operator credential

FleetBroadcasts.claim: routing on fleet, brain, project, target role, channel, revision and expiry; once and until_ack policies; optional claim id replays the same answer; older seat generations are fenced
FleetBroadcasts.acknowledge, delivery, duplicate_acknowledgements, broadcast_delivery_lag_seconds, current, history
FleetBroadcasts.freeze, thaw, frozen: switch distributed publication off and on
scripts.swarm_v2.broadcasts.local_entry, sync_local (only with AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_BROADCASTS=1) and acknowledge_local

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards passed in the linked CI run
supported_versions.coordination: SV2-CTL launch grants (LaunchAuthority), Redis WATCH/MULTI on the broadcast keys under the swarm root, five write attempts
supported_versions.compatibility: With AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_BROADCASTS unset, sync_local writes nothing and the broadcast file behaves as before; hook injection shows fleet entries only to the session that claimed them, while list_broadcasts and the CLI listing still show every entry

states.observed: Drafts from operator credentials and launch grants; claims from subscribed seats
states.accepted: A draft whose credential or grant validates for this swarm and whose fields pass the draft schema
states.committed: Redis WATCH/MULTI transaction on broadcasts, broadcast-history and broadcast-operations with broadcasts-frozen watched (publish); on broadcast-deliveries, broadcast-claims and broadcast-generations with broadcasts watched (claim); on broadcast-deliveries with broadcast-generations watched, plus broadcast-duplicate-acks inside the same transaction (acknowledge)
states.externally_verified: None; no hook delivers fleet broadcasts yet

recovery_contract.obligation: Reconnecting workers replay unexpired undelivered messages without duplicating acknowledged content
recovery_contract.result: The reconnected generation receives only unexpired undelivered revisions, a claim id retry writes nothing new, and the older generation is fenced with stale_generation

validation.red: https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38056370675 on the tests-only commit failed collecting the tests: the broadcasts module did not exist
validation.unit: All Python unit shards on 3.11 and 3.12 passed; 61 broadcast test ids, 122 PASSED rows, none failed; case A ran twice on independent fixtures
validation.mutation: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/38059547429 passed on eea0a651: broadcasts.py 817 killed, hooks/context/broadcast.py 105 killed, no survivors
validation.review: Standards and Spec readers closed after three rounds
validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on eea0a651

measurements.dimension: Each test has its own fakeredis swarm built from fleet-broadcasts.json; publish 1000 ms, claim 61000 ms

rollback_rehearsal.action: FleetBroadcasts.freeze disables distributed publication: operator and agent publishes are refused distribution_disabled without writing, claims still deliver what was published, history is unchanged; thaw re-enables it. Unsetting AGENTIHOOKS_FLEET_BROADCASTS stops sync_local and keeps the local file path
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: broadcasts, broadcast-history, broadcast-operations and broadcast-deliveries are authoritative and no code path deletes them; freeze only sets broadcasts-frozen

remaining_limitations: No hook calls sync_local or acknowledge_local yet: workers carry no launch grant into the hook environment (ledger follow-up filed), so hook-side delivery and local acknowledgement are not complete
freeze and thaw are not authenticated
At the message cap cache_fleet_broadcasts evicts fleet cache entries before local ones, while create_broadcast still trims the oldest entry of any kind
broadcast_delivery_lag_seconds is collected as evidence only; no metric exporter emits it
hooks/mcp/channels.py still publishes to the local broadcast file only
